title: Hybrid RAG knowledge assistant (Python)
summary: BM25 and dense vectors over only what the asker may read, fused by reciprocal rank and reranked by a cross-encoder (CPU, ONNX, no vector database); cited answers and refusals, a trace of every answer, portable knowledge cores, and a gate against BM25 alone, and web pages fetched into the corpus under an allow-list.
verified: RUN: the 72 tests (the crawler's against a local web server) on Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13 with the offline embedder and reranker, and the 43 golden questions with bge-small-en-v1.5 and ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 on a Linux CPU: hybrid 41 of 43 against 38 of 43 for BM25 alone, refusals 5 of 5, the 3 scope questions 3 of 3, 0 safety violations. NOT RUN: a model writing the answers.
stack_line: A hybrid retrieval-augmented assistant in Python 3.11+ (SQLite FTS5, NumPy, fastembed ONNX models).
run_cmd: uv run -m arag ask "How many vacation days do I get?"
next: Point [corpus] in arag.toml at your documents and rewrite evals/golden.jsonl with your questions.
Run uv run -m arag calibrate, then set [rerank] min_score from what it shows.
Keep uv run -m arag compare --gate in CI: hybrid must never be worse than BM25 alone.

ai_act.purpose: Answers people's questions from the team's documents and cites the sources it used.
notice: Answers are written by AI from your documents. Check the cited source before you act on one.

open_line: Embeddings and the reranker are open models that run on your machine; answers can come from an open-weight model through any OpenAI-compatible server.
cost_line: the system block cached on every model call; outline navigation on its own `navigate_model` (a small model is enough) and answers on `answer_model`; repeat questions answered from a cache kept per reader's access and index version; embeddings and reranking on the CPU, so retrieval costs no tokens; at most five sections reach the model.
container_check: docker run --rm --network none app:ci uv run -m arag eval --gate
